messages:
Ava (CS): quick heads-up re: BrightGrid onboarding, saw a pattern in their trial traffic — occasional latency spikes and token burn on multi-turn flows. thinking proactive ops before renewal convo :thinking_face:
Ravi (AE): thanks, Ava. renewal flag is at 45% likelihood — any concrete perf levers you want us to push?
Ava (CS): yes — propose small experiment: int8 quant for the default path + routing high-confidence short prompts to a cheaper variant. keep full-precision for long-context/doc-heavy requests. want to coordinate with eng to stage a canary.
Marta (ML Eng): sounds good. we can run a canary on 5% of traffic. quick plan:
- baseline: current fp16 model (g4dn)
- canary A: int8 quantized v1 (same arch)
- canary B: smaller distilled policy for short prompts
we'll track latency, p95 tail, and semantic drift on eval set. :mag:
Jordan (Solutions): who owns the eval set for BrightGrid? we should capture typical multi-turn sequences and a few API-edge cases (system messages, tool calls). I'll pull sample prompt logs and tag them.
Ava (CS): I'll export 48h of anonymized prompt traces and share in the enablement doc. want to include churn signals + customer feedback so sales can mention this in renewal touchpoints.
inference-bot: alert: recent deploy triggered 502 spikes for route "chat-legacy" 1718348000-1718348100
Marta (ML Eng): noted. those 502s are separate but could inflate perceived instability. i'll correlate with the canary window.
Ravi (AE): what's the rollback plan if quality dips? customer will be sensitive.
Marta (ML Eng): rollback = route all traffic back to fp16 variant via routing policy; keep logs for diffing. also automatic fallback: if top-1 confidence < 0.6 or token-penalty triggers, route to fp16. snippet for routing rule:```json
{
  "route": "brightgrid-main",
  "policies": [
    {"condition": "prompt_length < 256 && confidence >= 0.6", "model": "distilled-v1"},
    {"condition": "confidence < 0.6", "model": "fp16-v2"},
    {"default": "int8-v1"}
  ]
}
```
Jordan (Solutions): nice, can we add a canary metric dashboard and a simple SLA note for the customer? they asked for predictable latency in the renewal call.
Ava (CS): yes — schedule a short 30m sync with BrightGrid PM, include a before/after dashboard snapshot, and a runbook for rollback. I'll draft the customer-facing note.
Ravi (AE): timeline?
Marta (ML Eng): canary readiness by EOW if we get the eval set today. will instrument p95, error-rate, tokens/call, semantic-accuracy (eval prompts).
Ava (CS): i'll upload traces in the shared drive and ping here. also capturing their enablement feedback: they want clearer cost projection post-quant. include a simple table in the note with projected savings.
Jordan (Solutions): i can draft the cost table and a one-pager explaining the risk/benefit tradeoffs.
Ava (CS): perfect. tagging next steps:
- Ava: upload traces + schedule BrightGrid 30m sync (by 1718430000)
- Marta: prepare quant canary + dashboards (EOW)
- Jordan: one-pager + SLA blurb (2 days)
- Ravi: prep renewal talking points and cost estimates (2 days) :thumbsup:
Ravi (AE): great, thanks team. keep me posted with any quality flags. :eyes:
